_timezone_comment: Ham radio operates in UTC universally — set 'timezone': 'UTC' to interpret all 'at' and 'window' time values as UTC. Use 'local' if you want naive system-local time. Default if the field is missing or unknown: UTC. The choice is read once at daemon start; restart the service after changing it.

station._comment: role: free-form description for journal/log only. radio: cosmetic ID. callsign_must_be_set: validator refuses to load if user.json still has N0CALL.
station.role: Autonomous HF + VHF station — JS8 presence, scheduled Winlink check-ins

presence._comment: ─ Night shift: JS8 on 40m ─ rig_mode picks Hamlib mode token (PKTUSB for HF digital). FT-897D uses FM-D for VHF data, NOT PKTFM — backend varies, verify with `rigctl -m <model> -r /dev/null` then `m`. rig_bw=0 = let the rig pick its default filter (FT-897D doesn't accept arbitrary passbands). rig_levels: Hamlib levels in normalized 0.0-1.0; only rigs whose backend exposes `Set level: SQL/RF` will honour them. FT-897D ignores most. FT-991A honours all.
─ Daytime: VarAC on 20m ─ same fields. Demonstrates a second presence window. Schedule design: presence windows should COVER the full day with no gaps — validator warns if there are gaps.

missions._comment: ─ Midnight Winlink, simple skip-on-fail ─ Operator owns connect_url VERBATIM. The 'freq=' inside the URL is also used by the daemon for pre-mission QSY band-check (parses freq from URL). rms is informational only — the actual target callsign is inside connect_url. timeout_min is the mission hard-cap; the daemon kills the mission if it hasn't completed by then. days: optional list — if omitted, runs every day.
missions.name: Midnight Winlink (80m local)

missions._comment: ─ Morning Winlink with retry_alt ─ on_fail=retry_alt + alt_rms list. When the primary mission ends with state=failed (detected via QtPatWinlink's UDP broadcast on port 7456), the daemon walks alt_rms top-to-bottom. Each alt entry MUST have rms + connect_url. Optional overrides per alt: mode, rig_mode, rig_bw, rig_levels, rig_memory, timeout_min. Anything not overridden is inherited from the parent mission.
missions.name: Morning Winlink (40m regional)

alt_rms._comment: Backup #1: in-band 40m. Inherits mode + rig_mode from parent.
Backup #2: different band (80m). connect_url contains the new freq, no other override needed unless the band requires a different rig_mode/rig_bw.
Backup #3: cross-mode fallback — VHF VARA FM. Overrides mode (winlink-vara-fm) and rig_mode (FM-D for FT-897D, PKTFM for FT-991A).

missions._comment: ─ Midday DX Winlink (20m) ─ Demonstrates a mid-day mission overlapping with the daytime VarAC presence. Daemon stops VarAC, fires the mission, then restarts VarAC after the mission ends. on_fail=skip means: one shot, no retry.
missions.name: Midday DX Winlink (20m)

missions._comment: ─ Local VHF check-in via memory channel ─ rig_memory=5 ONLY works on rigs whose Hamlib backend implements set_mem (E command). FT-991A / IC-7100 = YES. FT-897D = NO (RIG_ENAVAIL). On supported rigs the daemon issues `V MEM` + `E 5` and skips rig_mode/rig_bw/rig_levels/qsy_khz — those settings live in the channel. The daemon tells the supervisor skip_qsy=true so its band-check doesn't override.
missions.name: Local VHF check-in (2m FM, memory channel)

missions._comment: ─ Same VHF mission for FT-897D (no memory-channel CAT) ─ Uses individual rig commands instead. rig_mode=FM-D is the FT-897D Hamlib token for VHF FM-Data (PKTFM is REJECTED on this backend). Verify your rig with: rigctl -m <model> -r /dev/null then type `1` and check the `Mode list:` line.
missions.name: Local VHF check-in (2m FM, FT-897D)

missions._comment: ─ UHF check-in (70cm FM, weekdays only) ─ days filter limits this mission to Mon-Fri. Saturday/Sunday skipped entirely. Useful for work-related check-ins, ARES nets, etc.
missions.name: Weekday UHF check-in (70cm)

boot._comment: start_current_presence: when the daemon starts (e.g. after boot), should it auto-start the presence whose window covers `now`? delay_seconds: how long to wait after boot before starting (gives audio / CAT services time to come up).

_override_flag_comment: Path to the pause sentinel. Touch this file to disable automation, remove it to enable. The QtDashboard AUTOMATION toggle (TOOLS group) writes to this same path. Also auto-written by the daemon when it detects operator intervention (manual mode start or stop of our presence).
